name: HVDC transmission and interconnectors
principle: Converter stations change AC to DC for long-distance or subsea transmission with lower losses than AC lines. Line-commutated (LCC) converters suit bulk power and AC interconnections; voltage-source converters (VSC) are compact and suit offshore wind.

process_steps.name: Transmit over DC cable or overhead line
